snippet.title: 3Dash Ultra Trailer
snippet.description:
Get now at https://zylex.co/3dash

This Project has many new features over normal 3Dash, including...
New Wide Slopes
Improved Physics
Noclip
Speedhack
Built-in Macro System
Better Editor Features such as Keep Checkpoints and Custom Songs

The 3Dash Ultra Discord:
https://discord.gg/z3kjk2KWyh
